author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Test build 1.8.6. Installs alongside the release version; your existing install is untouched.

FIXED: a failed scan attempt could show a raw, unreadable error ('Unexpected token <, "<!DOCTYPE" is not valid JSON') instead of saying what actually went wrong. The Scan button now checks the hub's response before trying to read it, and reports the real HTTP error if the request itself failed - reported by JimB on the community thread.

FIXED: browser Back and Forward inside the map could disagree with what was on screen after using Exit or Show all, because two separate mechanisms (a JS array and the browser's own history) had to be kept in step by hand. Rewritten so the browser's own history is the only source of truth - Back, Forward and Exit are now all correct in any order, including the specific 'Back to X' label.

The unconnected-apps shelf at the bottom of the map is now sorted alphabetically.

Reports welcome on the community thread.
